phone.title: Phone number (single)
phone.description: One Indian mobile in E.164 format. Examples: +91XXXXXXXXXX, +919876543210. Either `phone`, `vpa`, `phones[]`, or `vpas[]` must be provided.

vpa.title: VPA (single - direct lookup of a known UPI ID)
vpa.description: A specific UPI VPA you already know (e.g. `anshumanatrey@okhdfcbank`). Use when enumeration cannot guess the username portion.

phones.title: Phone numbers (bulk array)
phones.description: Multiple Indian mobiles. Each is processed independently and produces one dataset record.

vpas.title: VPAs (bulk array - direct lookups)
vpas.description: Multiple known VPAs to look up directly. Each is processed independently and produces one dataset record.

depth.title: Enumeration depth (only used when phone or phones[] is provided)
depth.description: tier1 (13 most common handles, ~70% coverage) | tier2 (20 handles, ~85%) | exhaustive (all 35 known handles, ~97%).

razorpayKeyId.title: Razorpay live key_id (only the key_id, NO secret)
razorpayKeyId.description: Razorpay live key_id for free phone→VPA enumeration. Public-safe (designed to live in frontend code). Without it, enumeration phase is skipped.

payuKey.title: PayU merchant key
payuKey.description: PayU production merchant key. Used with `payuSalt` to resolve each active VPA to its full bank-registered name via PayU validateVPA (~₹1-3 per call).

payuSalt.title: PayU merchant salt
payuSalt.description: PayU production salt paired with the merchant key for SHA512 hash signing.
